dedupe_keys.name: estimating the energy savings of energy efficiency actions with ensemble machine learning models

description: Sarmas, Elissaios and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented predictor estimates the energy savings of prospective energy-efficiency renovations before investment approval. It combines three tree-based bagging/boosting algorithms with an additional ensemble stage and evaluates them on a database of diverse renovation investments. The ensemble outperforms the individual models in the reported comparison, but no numeric error is supplied in the abstract. This supports appraisal of physical building-efficiency interventions under the sampled project categories. The source does not establish that the investment database is openly available or that every project has realized the predicted savings. Public executable code remains unspecified. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
